description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopQuery" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopOffer" name="Shop offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Webshops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all web shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Webshops" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers" sourceRef="Participant_Webshops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_ShopOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts orders" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_Webshops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_Webshops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDelivery" name="Subsequent parts batches" sourceRef="Participant_Webshops" targetRef="Start_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest-part reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Webshops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Fastest-part reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Webshops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyParts" name="Identify required parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive shop offers" messageRef="Message_ShopOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offers_Compare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare available quantities, prices, and delivery times">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offers_Compare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compare_Sufficiency</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShopSufficiency" name="Can one shop supply the required quantity?" default="Flow_Insufficient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compare_Sufficiency</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sufficient</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insufficient</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapestShop" name="Select the cheapest sufficient shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sufficient</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SingleShop_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SplitAcrossShops" name="Split the order across shops for the cheapest parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insufficient</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MultipleShops_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShopSelectionMerge" name="Shop selection complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SingleShop_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MultipleShops_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_CreateLists</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a parts order list for each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_CreateLists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Lists_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialOrders" name="Send initial parts orders" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Lists_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_FirstBatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Wait for the first parts batch (delivery typically varies by about 2 days)" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_FirstBatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstBatch_UpdateStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateFirstStock" name="Update stock for the first delivered batch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstBatch_UpdateStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Start building the contract project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract project built">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_LaterDelivery" name="Record subsequent parts batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LaterDelivery" name="Subsequent batch arrives in random order (typically about 2 days early or late)" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterDelivery_Update</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock from delivered batch">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterDelivery_Update</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_LaterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterDelivery" name="Batch recorded">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_LaterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterDelivery_Update" sourceRef="Start_LaterDelivery" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_LaterEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="End_LaterDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockBelowFive" name="Reorder when a part's stock falls below five" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelowFive" name="A part's stock falls below 5" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelowFive">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock(part) < 5</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheapReorder_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest-shop reorder sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheapReorder_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Reorder" sourceRef="Start_StockBelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorder_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="End_CheapReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockBelowThree" name="Reorder again when a part's stock falls below three" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelowThree" name="A part's stock falls below 3" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelowThree">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock(part) < 3</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FastReorder_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FastReorder" name="Fastest-shop reorder sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FastReorder_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Reorder" sourceRef="Start_StockBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorder_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="End_FastReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockZero" name="Complain when a part's stock is zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockZero" name="A part's stock reaches zero" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockZero">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock(part) = 0</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_ZeroEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ZeroComplaint" name="Complaint email sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_ZeroEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Email" sourceRef="Start_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_ZeroEnd" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="End_ZeroComplaint"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_IdentifyParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Query" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyParts" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Compare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare_Sufficiency" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Gateway_ShopSufficiency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sufficient" name="One shop is sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSufficiency" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapestShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insufficient" name="No single shop is sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSufficiency" targetRef="Task_SplitAcrossShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SingleShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapestShop" targetRef="Gateway_ShopSelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MultipleShops_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SplitAcrossShops" targetRef="Gateway_ShopSelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_CreateLists" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSelectionMerge" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_UpdateStock" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateFirstStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Build" sourceRef="Task_UpdateFirstStock" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
